title: Dashboard
noStats: The server reported no counters for this product.

hints.tenants: All tenants of this product, active and suspended.
hints.users: People with access to this product: members of its tenants and product operators, each counted once.
hints.apiKeys: Keys of this product that are not revoked. Expired keys are included.
hints.records: Records in all collections and tenants of this product.
hints.audit24h: Audit events of this product in the last 24 hours, allowed and denied.
hints.denied24h: Requests of the last 24 hours that were refused, for example because a permission was missing. A sudden rise often points to a misconfigured API key or role.

tenantHints.tenants: Tenants of this product in which you are a member.
tenantHints.users: Members of your tenants, each counted once (only tenants in which you may see members).
tenantHints.records: Records in your tenants (only tenants in which you may read records).

server.title: Server
server.name: Server version
server.modeInfo: Single product: the server serves exactly one product, created from its configuration; products cannot be created or archived. Multi product: platform administrators create and archive products. The operator sets the mode in the server configuration.
server.modulesInfo: Functional blocks of the server. Green modules are enabled; gray ones are not, and their sidebar entries show “Off”. Only the server operator can enable a module.

tenantScope: These figures cover only the tenants you belong to. Product-wide figures such as API keys and audit events need a product role.
